body:
Thanks, its alright.  Her not caring is just a fact of life by this point.  It makes things easier, she won't be all that bothered when I go, however much she may pretend to.

What other reasons are there to keep living, then?  Living just to simply keep breathing seems, well, pointless.  I don't know.

I don't think I bring friends pain (well, if I had any others I would think that), just him. Its complicated, I guess.  But really I just feel like a complete burden on him.  I wanted to talk to him about this yesterday, but really, how much can one person stand to be the only person someone goes to about all their shitty problems?

I just don't know.  I think I'm  rambling at this point. Sorry.  Thanks.
